summary: The translates of K(g)_T by the representatives of the reduced image are disjoint and cover (μ-a.e.) the integral group at T; by right invariance each has measure μ(K(g)).

steps.claim: For each s in the reduced image choose k_s ∈ B ∩ K with reduction s.
steps.lean: choose k c b using fun s : S.reducedImage B ↦ s.2

steps.claim: μ(K) = Σ_s μ(congGroup(F)·k_s): the translates are disjoint (different reductions, reduction_eq_iff) and, a.e., every point of K at T is in one of them.
steps.lean:
refine .trans ?_ ((measure_iUnion (fun s t n ↦ disjoint_left.2 fun z u v ↦ n (by
    ext1; simpa [← b, hF.reduction_eq_iff] using mul_mem (inv_mem u.out) v)) fun s ↦
    measurable_mul_const (S.toPlaces T (k s)) (P.measurableSet_unitaryLevel (g := F.g))).symm.trans
    (measure_congr (a.mono fun | _, ⟨x, a, rfl, o⟩ => propext (mem_iUnion.trans ⟨fun ⟨s, n⟩ ↦
    (mul_mem_cancel_right (mem_latStabilizer_iff.1 (k s).2).2).1 (P.unitaryLevel_le_unitaryLevel_one
    n), fun n ↦ ⟨_, by simpa using (hF.reduction_eq_iff ..).1 (b ⟨_,
    ⟨x, mem_latStabilizer_iff.2 ⟨o, n⟩⟩⁻¹, inv_mem a, rfl⟩).symm⟩⟩))))

steps.claim: Each translate has measure μ(congGroup(F)) (right invariance).
